title: Expose one harmless value
summary: contextBridge can expose a chosen value to the renderer without sharing full Node tools.
introduction: contextBridge can expose a chosen value to the renderer without sharing full Node tools. Your task: Read window.club.name from renderer.js.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for expose one harmless value

blocks.text: contextBridge can expose a chosen value to the renderer without sharing full Node tools. Keep the exposed surface small.

Use a local Electron project with electron installed as a dev dependency and main.cjs as its main file. Run with npx electron . after creating package.json and index.html. These APIs do not run in a web-page playground.

blocks.title: Expose one harmless value

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `contextBridge` exposes only the named approved value or function to the page. It should not expose all Node or IPC methods.

blocks.text: The renderer can read the club name through window.club.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not expose require, filesystem modules or raw Electron objects to the renderer.
